Existing shareholders will collectively divest nearly six percent of NSE's stake in the offer.  NSE dominates India's equity derivatives market and operates the Nifty 50 index.

Lakshmi dreams of becoming a teacher, while her story also highlights the importance of inclusive, accessible education and support for children with disabilities.
